name: Mouana Mai Khao
shortDescription: 26 private pool villas of 3 and 4 bedrooms (about 400-433 sqm built, 600 sqm plots) near Mai Khao Beach, by Mouana Phuket, from THB 26 million.
description:
Mouana Mai Khao is a project of 26 private pool villas in Mai Khao by Mouana Phuket, on a site of about 23,484 sqm with a clubhouse, communal pool, gym and kids zone. FazWaz lists it as Mouana Breeze Maikhao; other portals call it Mouana Mai Khao.
Advertised homes are fully furnished 3 and 4 bedroom villas of 400-433 sqm built area on 600 sqm plots, with 4-5 bathrooms. The lowest advertised price is THB 26 million for a 4 bedroom villa, THB 28.9 million for the 3 bedroom model and THB 31 million for the larger 4 bedroom. Phuket International Airport is about 10 km (16 minutes by car) and Splash Jungle Water Park about 1.8 km away.
The villas are sold made to order, with a stated build time of about 12 months. Earlier listings showed lower prices (from about 19.9 million), so confirm the current price list and handover date with us on WhatsApp.

researchNotes: Several name variants (Mouana Breeze Maikhao) assumed same project. Price list 19.9M (old) vs 21.9-25.9M (newer) conflict, so price on request. Completion 2025 Q2 to Q3 2027. Checked 2026-11-17. 2026-11-23 FazWaz project page: 26 units, 1 building, 23,484 sqm site, made to order (12 months), from THB 26.0M; units 4BR/5BA 400 sqm 26.0M, 3BR/4BA 404 sqm 28.9M, 4BR/5BA 433 sqm 31.0M, plots 600 sqm, fully furnished, pool view. Replaces the earlier "price on request" because FazWaz now shows a consistent list. Ownership and payment plan not stated. Nearby places refreshed 2026-11-23: beaches, hospitals, big stores (Tesco Lotus, Big C, Makro), markets, schools and kindergartens added from OpenStreetMap as straight-line distances from the FazWaz project coordinates (not road distance). Where a category already had a distance from the developer or a portal, it was kept and not replaced.
